milia_like_cysts.evidence: Lower central area: a few tiny whitish dots are seen, but they may be hair follicle openings or light reflections rather than true keratin cysts.

Several whitish-translucent globular structures at upper and right periphery (e.g., upper center, right side) resemble keratin cysts, though they look more like scale/keratin clods than discrete round milia-like dots

comedo_like_openings.evidence: Dark brown-black round plugged openings in the central dark area (center right, near lower center of pigmented zone) and small dark dots at upper left edge

fissures_ridges.evidence: Central dark area shows irregular furrowed, somewhat cerebriform texture, but not a clear brain-like pattern

glomerular_vessels.evidence: Within the upper and central part of the keratotic mass there are a few small tortuous, coiled red-purple structures. They may be glomerular vessels, but they are hard to tell apart from hemorrhage within the keratin.

hairpin_vessels.evidence: Along the upper and left periphery of the lesion, elongated red looped vessels sit within whitish halos. They are arranged radially around the central yellow-white keratin mass.

polymorphous_vessels.evidence: Looped vessels at the upper periphery appear alongside some linear-irregular and possibly coiled vessels. However, the central red-purple spots look more like hemorrhage than true vessels, so a mix of vessel types is not clearly shown.

glomerular_vessels.evidence: Pink nodule around the central crust shows faint, blurred reddish dot-like areas, especially at the right and lower portions. Focus is too soft to resolve coiled glomerular morphology.

hairpin_vessels.evidence: Elongated red vessels radiate from the central keratin crust toward the left and lower periphery of the nodule, some set on whitish background. Their looped hairpin form cannot be clearly resolved.

polymorphous_vessels.evidence: The nodule shows linear-irregular and possibly looped vessels around the keratin mass, with a few dot-like red foci near the crust. Whether two or more distinct vessel types are present is not clear enough to call confidently.

fibrillar_pattern.evidence: Across the central brown lesion there are fine, closely spaced, slightly oblique parallel brown streaks that could represent fibrillar filaments. The image is somewhat blurry, so they cannot be confidently told apart from a parallel furrow pattern.

blue_gray_ovoid_nests.evidence: Faint small blue-gray dots/globules just left of center near the lesion's lower left edge; small and poorly defined.

shiny_white_structures.evidence: Whitish structureless area in the upper center of the pink lesion, but no clear shiny lines; overlying hairs make it hard to judge.

short_fine_telangiectasias.evidence: Pinkish-red erythema in the upper center; individual fine vessels are not clearly resolved.

multiple_small_erosions.evidence: A single small dark red-brown crust/erosion at the center of the lesion; not multiple.

in_focus_dots.evidence: A few tiny blue-gray dots at the left-center part of the lesion; subtle.

blue_gray_ovoid_nests.evidence: Center: small cluster of dark brown to purplish-gray globules; more brown than blue-gray, so not a classic example.

shiny_white_structures.evidence: Whitish structureless areas around the central pigmented cluster; no clear orthogonal shiny lines.

short_fine_telangiectasias.evidence: Fine short red vessels scattered over the pink background, with a cluster of fine reddish-orange vessels right of center.

multiple_small_erosions.evidence: Tiny orange-yellow dots scattered across the field could be small crusts, but they are indistinct.

concentric_structures.evidence: Central globule cluster: some globules may have darker centres, but this is not clearly seen.

in_focus_dots.evidence: Small dark dots at the periphery of the central pigmented cluster; brownish rather than clearly blue-gray.

lattice_pattern.evidence: Small brown lesion at upper center shows a few roughly horizontal parallel brown lines joined by short perpendicular strokes, suggesting a ladder-like lattice arrangement. The lesion is tiny and blurry, so the pattern cannot be confirmed.

shiny_white_structures.evidence: Bright white short lines and blotches in the center and lower right of the lesion (around the dark blotch at bottom right and the central area), seen under polarized light.

peripheral_brown_structureless.evidence: Light brown featureless rim along the lesion periphery, most evident at the left, lower and right edges, surrounding the dark blue-gray center.

milky_red_areas.evidence: Faint pinkish-red hue at the upper left periphery, with small reddish dots; not a clear strawberry-milk area.

parallel_ridge.evidence: Along the lower and lower-right border, pigment forms broad, parallel, finger-like bands separated by thin pale lines, following the acral skin markings. Scattered whitish dots within the dark bands may be eccrine pores, which would place the pigment on the ridges.
